messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — just finished a run-through with Prometheus Health. They signed but stressed SLO alignment during onboarding. They want a formal downtime/credit report for the first 30 days and a clear acceptance artifact for renewal. Looping SRE + PM to triage.

jordan_ae: Quick Q — contract shows 99.95% for Dedicated, but onboarding playbook we gave them references 99.9%. Which wins?

maria_cs: Contractually 99.95 is the promise, but their renewal committee is evaluating against 99.9 for the pilot period. We need to document discrepancies & propose credits if the recent blip counts.

sam_sre: I can pull the incident logs. We had a brief ~8m degradation last week during their seed rollout in eu-west-2. Will paste the timeline here.

sam_sre: ```2025-11-12T03:14Z - 2025-11-12T03:22Z: eu-west-2 GPU pool OOM -> autoscaler thrash -> request throttling. Impact window ~8m. Metrics: p95 latency spike 2.3s -> 7.4s, error rate 0.6% -> 4.1%.```

lucas_pm: Suggest we offer a one-time onboarding credit and an SLO report they can present to execs. My initial thought: 10% credit for that month + a formal post-onboarding report. Open to lower if Legal pushes back.

jordan_ae: CS usually aims to keep credits modest. For outages under 30m we often do 3-5%. But because this is during the onboarding window and affects renewal posture, be prepared to justify higher. Also they want a dashboard snapshot for their audit meeting.

ops_bot: Automated export: Dashboard CSV available — https://console.redwood/slo-exports/prometheus-health/2025-11-01_2025-11-30.csv

maria_cs: :eyes: Can someone draft the 1-page incident report (timeline + metrics + root cause + mitigations) and a short credit calc? I need both for Thurs's customer walkthrough.

sam_sre: I'll draft the incident narrative and include raw metrics + graphs. Mitigations: rolled back batch config, patch applied to kernel memory allocator, adjusted autoscaler thresholds.

lucas_pm: I'll draft credit calc and route to Legal. Proposal: 10% credit for Nov invoice; fallback 5% if Legal objects.

jordan_ae: I'll assemble the final report once we have SRE and credit language. Also will prepare the short deck for the customer renewal call.

maria_cs: Can someone capture a short acceptance email template for the customer to sign after the walkthrough? We need written ack for the renewal file.

lucas_pm: Draft template: "We acknowledge Redwood's remediation and accept the proposed credit of X% for the affected period. We consider this issue closed for the purposes of our onboarding acceptance." I'll add to Asana.

devops_bot: Deploy bot: patch v2.3.1 applied to eu-west-2 at 2025-11-13T02:02Z — service restart completed, health checks green.

jordan_ae: Action items recap: Sam -> incident narrative + metrics; Lucas -> credit calc + Legal; Maria -> schedule customer walkthrough & collect ack; Jordan -> assemble final report & deck; Ops -> export dashboard snapshots.

maria_cs: Assigned tasks in Asana: https://app.asana.com/0/1200/345678901234567 — please update your task with attachments and ETA by EOD tomorrow.

sam_sre: Got it — will attach logs and graphs to the Asana task. ETA EOD tomorrow.

lucas_pm: I'll ping Legal today and update the task with their guidance. If they push back, propose 5% and call it a one-time onboarding concession.

maria_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll schedule Thurs 9am PT and send the calendar invite to the customer + internal rehearsals.

jordan_ae: One more note — capture the KB link we used so CS can reference the mitigation in postmortem: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west-2-oom-mitigation

maria_cs: Perfect. Closing loop here — will post final report after the rehearsal and paste the customer acceptance email into the Asana task.
